body:
AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'sweep-adopt-veridian-scripts-213-fix-orchestrator-mirror-prompt-os-resolv' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  PROGRESS.md                        | 276 ++++++--------
 PROGRESS_PR207_task-181155.md      | 123 +++++++
 superboss-register.py              | 402 ++++++++++++++++++++
 tests/test_unified_orchestrator.py | 626 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 unified_orchestrator.py            | 728 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 5 files changed, 1996 insertions(+), 159 deletions(-)
Evidence Recorded: The actual code changes are well-constructed (parameterized SQL throughout, enum-validated status/verdict columns, idempotent schema/seed helpers, fail-loud prompt-template resolution, fire-and-forget execution logging that never blocks the real step, subprocess.run used with an argv list rather than shell=True for the find_code.sh call, and a real non-mocked end-to-end test suite for both positive and negative paths) and no .github/workflows/** files are touched. However, this PR's branch base (ab898ec, 2026-08-07) is 231 commits and roughly 8 days behind current origin/main (5a862e1, 2026-08-14), and a real merge-tree simulation (`git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD main`) confirms genuine, unresolved CONFLICT (content) hunks in both PROGRESS.md and, more importantly, superboss-register.py -- the actual code file this task modifies. Because tier1 approval here means 'merge to main autonomously', and the diff as submitted cannot be cleanly merged onto the current main tip, approving it as-is would either fail outright at the `gh pr merge` step or require ad hoc manual conflict resolution never reviewed by this pass. Rejecting rather than approving: the worker/task branch must be rebased (or merged) onto current origin/main, conflicts in superboss-register.py resolved by hand (verifying no silent collision with the ~231 commits of unrelated feature work main has gained since this branch diverged, including its own later, unrelated CLI subcommand and table additions), and the full test suite re-run against the rebased tip before this is re-submitted for review. Issues found: Branch is 231 commits / ~8 days behind current origin/main (base ab898ec vs main tip 5a862e1); `git merge-tree HEAD main` produces real, verified CONFLICT (content) in both PROGRESS.md and superboss-register.py -- not a hypothetical risk, confirmed directly against this repo's actual refs.; superboss-register.py is a heavily shared, frequently-modified file (grew from 7889 lines at this branch's merge-base to 10541 lines on current main via unrelated commits); the CLI argparse subparser block and the final elif dispatch chain this PR appends to are exactly the kind of append-only region likely to collide with other concurrently-landed subcommands, so the conflict needs careful manual resolution, not a blind rebase --theirs/--ours.; No .github/workflows/** files are touched by this diff, so the hard workflow-scope rule does not apply here.
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
